title.zh: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍
title.en: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍

current_state.zh: Aptos Labs 提出的 MonoMove 执行引擎升级公布更多测试数据，称部分智能合约负载最高提速55倍、顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；仍需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。
current_state.en: Aptos Labs' proposed MonoMove execution-engine upgrade has additional test data: up to 55x faster on some smart contract workloads and up to 11x higher sequential throughput, subject to governance approval, with feature completeness expected by end of 2026 and mainnet rollout planned for 2027.

updates.title_zh: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍
updates.title_en: Aptos推出MonoMove，面向链上市场的引擎速度提升55倍
updates.what_changed_zh: Aptos Labs发布MonoMove，这是一项拟议的执行引擎改造，称可将智能合约运行速度提升至多55倍，并声称在其全链上交易平台Decibel上，抵押品提取速度可提升至多55倍，下单速度提升22倍。
updates.what_changed_en: Aptos Labs announced MonoMove, a proposed execution-engine overhaul it says can run smart contracts up to 55x faster, claiming up to 55x faster collateral withdrawals and 22x faster order placement on its fully on-chain trading venue Decibel.

updates.what_changed_zh: 新增信息：内部测试显示端到端顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；该升级需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。
updates.what_changed_en: Adds that internal tests show up to 11x higher end-to-end sequential throughput; the upgrade requires governance approval, with feature completeness expected by end of 2026 and mainnet rollout planned for 2027.
updates.current_state_zh: Aptos Labs 提出的 MonoMove 执行引擎升级公布更多测试数据，称部分智能合约负载最高提速55倍、顺序吞吐量最高提升11倍；仍需治理批准，预计2026年底功能完备，2027年主网上线。

updates.detailed_summary_zh: Aptos Labs proposed MonoMove, an execution-engine upgrade it says runs some smart contract workloads up to 55x faster and boosts sequential throughput up to 11x in internal tests, with governance approval needed ahead of a 2027 mainnet rollout.
